summary: A five-track generative groovebox for city pop and coastal styles: you pick one of 190 self-playing pieces across 19 genres and steer it live with breakdowns, builds, effects and an auto-DJ. A fork of PERF-1.
features: Pad, bass, 303-style acid line, pluck and drums generated live, not loops
Breakdown, build and drop buttons; auto-DJ and a Mood dial
93 playable effect keys in four banks, latch or hold
Drum sequencer: 6 lanes, 16 steps, ratchets, Euclid fills, polymeter
6-op FM pluck with 30 voices; load up to 16 DX7 voices over USB
Mixer with compressor and limiter; doesn't read other firmwares' saves
